summary: Retest of game chances persistence after Iteration 24 sync-write fix in useGameSession.ts (feature-detect window.localStorage + synchronous persist via refs inside grantChances/consume/reset). ALL FE-1 through FE-5 now PASS once a stale Metro bundle was cleared. Verified setItem calls captured for tm:game:hl, tm:game:memory, tm:game:math, tm:game:ttt with correct JSON payloads. Hydration on re-enter and on full page reload preserves chancesLeft and hasUnlocked correctly. Rewarded ad no longer auto-pops after chances are granted.
action_items: Bug is fixed. Optional: remove the dev-only debug console.warn lines from useGameSession.ts if not desired in production.

Cosmetic carry-over (not related to this fix): _layout.tsx still references non-existent routes admin/game-limits, coin-mine, plinko, treasure-hunt — Expo Router prints 4 warnings on every load. Harmless but noisy.

Recommend: when shipping similar persistence fixes in the future, force a Metro cache purge (rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache && supervisorctl restart expo) before testing — Metro served a stale bundle this run, which initially reproduced the iteration_23 symptom even though the file on disk was correct.
critical_code_review_comments: useGameSession.ts: clean and idiomatic. Refs (chancesRef/playsRef/unlockedRef) correctly mirror state so persist() is synchronous and race-free. Feature detection (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.localStorage !== 'undefined') is the right pattern and avoids the Platform.OS pitfall.

useGameSession.ts hydrate effect at line 98 sets hydrated=true after the async read; consuming screens correctly gate the auto-prompt on session.hydrated to avoid the modal flashing before hydration completes — verified in higher-lower.tsx line 70-73.

Minor: the AsyncStorage branch in kvSet returns Promise but the function signature is void (no await needed in caller). Acceptable since callers are fire-and-forget, but make the intent explicit with `void AsyncStorage.setItem(...).catch(...)`.

context_for_next_testing_agent: URL: https://github-sync-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Persistence bug is FULLY FIXED in iteration 24. Verification approach used: install setItem proxy on window.localStorage that pushes to window.__lsLog BEFORE clicking Claim Reward. All four games (Higher-Lower, Memory Match, Math Sprint, Tic-Tac-Toe) now correctly write tm:game:{hl|memory|math|ttt} synchronously inside grantChances/consume and hydrate on mount. NOTE: During first test attempt the bundle was stale (grep hasLocalStorage in served bundle returned 0); clearing /app/frontend/.metro-cache and restarting expo fixed it. If a future fix appears to not be applied, suspect Metro cache first.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 23 root cause was twofold: (1) Persistence relied on a useEffect tick that never fired (firstWrite ref + hydration flag timing), and (2) the Platform.OS === 'web' branch was unreliable in this Expo SDK 54 web bundle. Iteration 24 fix addresses both: (a) hasLocalStorage feature-detection runs at module load and always resolves to true in a browser, (b) refs (chancesRef/playsRef/unlockedRef) are updated synchronously and persist() is called inline inside grantChances/consume/reset — no effect tick required. Initial retest in iteration 24 appeared to reproduce the bug because Metro was serving a cached bundle from iteration 23. After `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo`, the served bundle correctly included the new hasLocalStorage and tm:game:hl symbols (verified via curl + grep) and all five test scenarios passed.
